prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1049
Claimant:
Ashley Smith
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
11/14/2024
First notice of loss received for a collision at an intersection in which the insured's vehicle was struck while the other
driver turned left across our insured's path. The claimant, who is not represented by counsel, reported a wrist injury
and is currently driving the insured vehicle as a household member of the policyholder.
12/25/2024
Spoke with the claimant, who described the crash the same way he did when first reported, saying the other vehicle
turned in front of him as he proceeded through the intersection. His account has not changed in any conversation so
far.
12/28/2024
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of impact and records the scene
as consistent with a left-turn collision. Independent witnesses and the other driver give statements that match the
claimant's version of events.
01/07/2025
Collected scene photographs showing front-end damage to the insured vehicle and the side of the other vehicle. The
photos are consistent with the reported impact, though I have not yet determined whether every area of damage
resulted from this single event.
02/13/2025
Requseted the claimant's medical records. The reported wrist fracture is a plausible injury for a collision of this type,
and no prior injury to that area appears in the file or was mentioned by the claimant.
04/04/2025
Treatment has followed a typical course, with the claimant attending scheduled follow-up visits and reporting steady
improvement. Care has tapered as expected, and the treating provider's notes match that progression.
04/07/2025
Confirmed with underwriting that no prior damage to the insured vehicle is on record and nothing indicates any
dmaage predates the start of coverage on this policy.
04/26/2025
Reviewed the repair estimate against the photos and the impact description. Some items on the estimate may not be
explained by this collision alone, so I have asked the repair facility for a more detailed braekdown before settling
those lines.
05/10/2025
Verified that the claimant is a household member of the policyholder and therefore qualifies as a covered driver under
the policy's terms. No exclusion applies based on the driver's relationship to the insured.
05/14/2025
Coverage is confirmed for the collision and the claimant's injury. Remaining open items are the detailed repair
breakdown and final medical billing. Reserves have been adjusted to reflect the current estimate, and the file will be
reviewed again once those documents arrive.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
